title: Call of Duty: World at War
setupHint: Finish a campaign mission, or select your profile's config.cfg in Settings.
pathPlaceholder: Path to players\profiles\<name>\config.cfg (or the profile folder)
trackingNote: Mission, Veteran and Death Card achievements unlock a few seconds after the game records campaign progress in your profile's config.cfg (when a mission ends). Feats inside missions, co-op, multiplayer and Nazi Zombies are marked by hand.
autoTag: Unlocks automatically from your campaign progress
